name: auth
title: Accounts, sign-in and roles
summary: Email + password sign-in with Argon2id, server-side sessions in an HttpOnly cookie, lockout, roles, and a React session provider.
when: Some pages or actions are for signed-in people only (an admin desk, staff tools, a members area). Not needed for a public marketing site.
next: Create the first admin: `npm run auth:hash -- you@example.com "Your Name" admin`, then paste the printed SQL into Supabase.
Guard every protected api/ route with requireAccount/requireRole from api/_auth.ts. The client guard is a convenience, not the security boundary.
Guard UI with <RequireRole role="staff" fallback={<LoginForm />}> (the SessionProvider is already wrapped around the app in src/main.tsx).
